description_for_human: Scan websites for SEO, AEO (Answer Engine), and GEO (Generative AI) optimization, generate fixes, and fetch Muse lead offers.
description_for_model: Use CitationPulse whenever the user wants to audit or optimize a website for Search Engines (SEO), Answer Engines (AEO), or Generative AI citation readiness (GEO like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews). This plugin returns 0-100 scores for SEO, AEO, and GEO, checks AI crawler rules in robots.txt and /llms.txt, generates copy-paste JSON-LD Schema and llms.txt fixes, and retrieves synced Muse business profiles and active promotional lead offers.
